subject: general
question: Which of the following States/Union Territories hosted the first-ever Food Processing Summit to attract investors to the region in January 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** first-ever Food Processing Summit** was held in **Union Territory Ladakh** in an effort to draw **business to the area.**
 
• The **Ministry of Food Processing Industries**, the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**, and the **UT Administration of Ladakh** convened this summit.
 
• Ladakh has huge potential for investment in the food processing industries for** agricultural items like buckwheat and barley **as well as **horticulture products** like **apricot, seabuckthorn, and apple.**
 
• The** purpose** of the event was to inspire business owners to launch a** StartUp** to take advantage of the opportunities in** Ladakh's food processing industries.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• ** As of October 2022: **

 
 
• **​Minister of Food Processing Industries: Shri Pashu Pati Kumar Paras**
 
• **Ministers of State of Food Processing Industries: Shri Prahalad Singh Patel**
